title: NoveltyLab · 相关特征与收缩协方差
question: 忽略特征相关性的中心距离，和只在正常训练拟合的协方差基线有什么差异？
findings: 协方差只拟合35条正常训练，13维估计不稳定，condition number必须报告。
12条正常验证不足以支持高置信误报保证；95%经验分位数非认证。
Wine类别人为异常定义不能外推工业故障。

protocol.threshold: 95th quantile of 12 normal validation rows, descriptive due tiny calibration
protocol.data: same public Wine test IDs; class0 normal, other classes constructed shift

scope: AI-assisted local investigation. Data/model/experiment limitations in per-project protocol. Not production, independent publication, hardware measurements or fully personal independent development.
